release_coverage: Complete AUTHOR_SEAL.json and all four sealed members were read. New sources are frozen separately; all PRE files are preserved.
scientific_result: No required mathematical correction to the conditional total-residence and first-hitting-time argument. Additive-energy implementation conclusion is valid with the finite-expectation and strong-conservation interpretation stated in POST.
required_quantifier_precision: Fixed graph, positive fixed couplings in the imported regime and fixed alpha in (0,4), then sufficiently large spin.
Uniform spin threshold over initial densities comes from the fixed-cap state-uniform estimate.
Hitting time depends on spin and initial ground density; no universal observation time with identical gain is selected.
Total residence measure includes all returns but alone is not a pointwise relaxation theorem.
The target is the unconditioned full ordinary mean energy, not an individual recorded energy or mark energy.
energy_ledger_precision: The author explicitly assumes additive energy conservation at the endpoints and no omitted energy or external work in that balance.
An unbounded reservoir requires well-defined expectations or nonnegative forms; an unexcited normal state requires attained ground support.
A conserving unitary requires strong commutation with additive energy, not merely a formal commutator.
Conservation of an interacting total Hamiltonian alone permits an interaction-energy contribution.
Passivity at nonzero temperature is not zero excitation; no heat/work/light or vacuum identification follows.
independence: This is comparison by the same checker after release, not another blind derivation. Author37 stays explicitly provisional. PRE additions retain their original attribution.
mutations: Only new POST files and frozen release copies in the existing external independent directory.
